note: The Commonwealth Bank, which serves Norfolk Island (its fee guide names the island's own stamp duty and GST on the bank's service fees): the Everyday Account Smart Access costs 4 dollars a month, waived in a month with at least 2,000 dollars deposited or for a holder under 30; the Yello tiers' and other waivers aren't written.

sources.title: Commonwealth Bank, Everyday Account Smart Access
sources.said: Monthly fee ... $4 or $0; the fee will be waived if: ... You deposit at least $2,000 per month (excludes Bank-initiated transactions), or ... You’re under 30 years of age, or

sources.title: Commonwealth Bank, fees and charges guide (effective October 2026)
sources.said: Effective October 2026 ... Norfolk Island also has specific charges such as Stamp Duty (payable on cheques issued in Norfolk Island) and Goods and Services Tax (on certain service fees the Bank provides). The Bank collects the Goods and Services Tax from you and passes this on to the Government.
